storeCopy.seoTitle: TikTok Music Details Scraper | Sound Data
storeCopy.seoDescription: Look up TikTok sounds by music URL for titles, authors, durations, covers, and linked video counts. Batch sound links to build audio research datasets.
storeCopy.intro: Look up public TikTok music pages and save the sound title, author, duration, cover, album, and linked video count. Submit multiple sound URLs in one run.
useCases: Music teams can check details and linked video counts for TikTok sounds.
Social analysts can connect popular audio to its public TikTok music page.
Content researchers can organize sound metadata from a list of URLs.
howToUse: Add each public TikTok music URL to `urls`.
Set `maxResults` to cap one record per submitted sound.
Read the nested `data` object or use the flattened sound columns.

faqs.question: Can I pass a video URL instead of a music URL?
faqs.answer: Use the public TikTok music page URL for this Actor. Video URLs belong in a video details workflow.

fields.name: code
fields.description: TikTok response status code; zero indicates a successful lookup.

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Status message returned with the music detail record.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Sound identifier, title, author, duration, cover, and associated video count.

fields.name: music_id
fields.description: TikTok music identifier returned for the sound.

fields.name: music_title

fields.name: music_play

fields.name: music_cover
fields.description: Cover image URL associated with the sound.

fields.name: music_album

fields.name: video_count
